svg.title: Plugins: one real call, the step you can swap and the steps that judge it
svg.desc: Five numbered steps of one real call, Goldwind on 2026-10-08. One: thirteen live rows, each in one socket, any of which can be swapped; five of them hand readings to a decision, and the factors row computed Goldwind's: trend off, 31.8 percent under its 200-day average. Two: the model argued a bull case and a bear case over that reading. Three: the plan on paper, watch, act only above 8.97 within five sessions, dead at 8.923, confidence 0.34. Below a line marked "not rows": four, code took 8.645 as the reference, marked the next close 4.22 percent lower and called it a loss; five, the loss went back onto the public ledger that the next brief reads. No row can mark its own call, pick a kinder reference, change the outcome or keep it off the ledger.

text.tspan: Swap what computes. Not what a result is allowed to do.
One real call, Goldwind · 02208, 2026-10-08: which step was a row, and which were not.
BARS, THE PANEL AND THE ADD-SIDE POLICIES · 8
A row turns inputs into a reading, and nothing more.
A row declares its inputs, its units and what it holds when it cannot measure. A broken row fails alone.

NOT ROWS FROM HERE DOWN · THE SAME CODE JUDGES EVERY STRATEGY
NOT THE MODEL · NOT THE ROW
Reference: the first price it could have traded at after
the plan was published. Marked at the next session’s close.
The track record the next brief reads
turn this loss into something else
Replace the factors row and Goldwind’s line is computed another way. Steps 04 and 05 do not move.
